metadata.description: TALXIS plugins for coding agents — build Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo with the TALXIS CLI (txc): scaffold, build, validate, and deploy deterministically.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design TALXIS / Power Platform work before building it: personas, the data model, where each behaviour runs, the user flows, and Gherkin features — from a problem statement in an empty folder, or against a repository that already exists. Read-only. Use when a change needs designing or specifying before any code is written.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: Build TALXIS / Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo: describe an app and /implement:builder scaffolds it end to end, or scaffold one concern at a time with the TALXIS CLI (txc). Validated with dotnet build, deployed as Package Deployer packages only when asked. Use when creating a new TALXIS project or working on an existing one.
